<div class="review-text">
Quantum League was one of my favorite shooters of all time. It has a really interesting and engaging gimmick that I loved to explore the intricacies of. The time I spent with it during its open beta was some of the most fun time I've ever had playing video games. The aesthetic quality of the game, the detail, and the heart that went into it is all abundantly clear. So while it breaks my heart to see that it didn't do well on its initial release (definitely a failure of marketing, not at all the game itself, which is excellent), I nevertheless would always cherish the ability to play this game with a friend while the servers are still online, and would be very grateful to introduce anybody to this fantastic and beautifully executed experience one last time.
</div>
